title: Combatting Gerrymandering with Ranked Choice Voting: an Experimental Analysis of Multi-member Districts in the United States
authors: Nikhil Garg; Wes Gurnee; David Rothschild; David Shmoys
main_caveat: The 19-row in-scope theorem ledger is Lean-closed: Lemma C.1 and Proposition 1 are formalized for the source-facing solid-coalition STV outcome predicate exposed in PaperInterface.lean. Redistricting optimization, map generation, simulations, and empirical claims remain explicit data/code boundaries rather than theorem-ledger targets.
human_summary: The gerrymandering paper's in-scope theorem ledger has shared PAV/Thiele tooling, Droop-quota arithmetic, a formalized PAV min-argmax-to-interval proof for Lemma C.1, reusable two-party proportionality bridges, terminal same-party quota-process certificates, and a Lean-closed Proposition 1 reduction for the formal solid-coalition STV outcome predicate. llm_statement_review.policy: Translate each Lean statement with an LLM that has no paper context and require it to preserve every visible binder, hypothesis, domain condition, equivalence direction, and conclusion. Have a third LLM compare that TeX/prose translation with the original full paper statement, not just the theorem label. A `matches` verdict requires equivalence of hypotheses, subparts, quantifiers, domains, constants, normalizations, signs, inequality directions, and conclusions; conditional wrappers, source-row packages, omitted subclaims, weakened/strengthened statements, or broad aggregates must be judged `mismatch` or `uncertain`. Record the model/agent validator metadata and iterate on PaperInterface.lean until the full statement matches. If the dashboard has more than 30 rows, run a no-paper-context LLM audit that checks whether every row is paper-facing; at 120 or more rows, curate the surface before broad human review.

llm_paper_coverage_review.policy: Maintain a paper_statement_map.json inventory of source definitions, formulas, and named statements, then use a separate LLM pass to judge whether each source item is covered by one or more dashboard rows. This paper-level accounting is required before calling a full-paper formalization closed and is separate from row-local statement matching.

llm_assumption_review.policy: Every paper-facing theorem premise not derived from prior Lean declarations must be declared in Assumptions.lean, listed in assumption_names, and judged by an independent LLM as a true paper/source model assumption rather than a proof assumption.
